messages.subject: For Fahad Al Hassawi | Digital infrastructure, regulation and government partnerships
messages.body:
Dear du Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Fahad Al Hassawi, Chief Executive Officer.

du's role as critical national digital infrastructure places government relations, regulation, enterprise technology and stakeholder confidence at the center of execution. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate regulated cross-functional matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regulatory strategy and emerging-market execution might support du's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to du.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
